scoped_source_context: Natural Earth 1:10m ADM1 fallback; Cook Islands MFEM 2026 domestic shipping policy and official climate/environment report
source_role_and_suitability_findings: Official service lists distinguish Northern and Southern outer-island shipping groups from Rarotonga and wider Pa Enua island lists. These are operational/service geographies, not evidence that each atlas physical island is a statutory province or that the generalized ADM1 polygon is legally adopted.
completeness_and_license_findings: Natural Earth is public domain and generalized with no completeness warranty. Official lists vary by service purpose and include islands outside this packet's partial slices. No authoritative complete current dry-land boundary source was found in this review.
recommendation: Do not invent policy from the ADM1 label. A future profile should define whether the intended unit is physical island/atoll or administrative/service entity and pin lawful island-by-island land evidence.

scoped_source_context: Natural Earth Pitcairn Islands ADM1 group comparator; UNESCO Henderson World Heritage description
source_role_and_suitability_findings: UNESCO supports the identity of Henderson as one of four Pitcairn-group islands and its nesting under that parent. Heritage description and the Natural Earth group do not define a dedicated current local administrative boundary for Henderson.
completeness_and_license_findings: Natural Earth is public domain, generalized and the retained object covers the four-island parent group, not Henderson alone. UNESCO is descriptive evidence, not a modern coastline dataset.
recommendation: Keep the current island identity and parent; obtain a lawful island-level coastline source and state clearly whether the intended tier is physical land or administration before proposing an outline.

scoped_source_context: Natural Earth 1:10m Admin1 archipelago/group features; French Polynesia DPAM and DCA planning/circumscription pages
source_role_and_suitability_findings: Official maritime/planning services use Windward, Leeward, Austral, Marquesas and Tuamotu-Gambier groupings. This supports recognizable physical/service group meaning but does not equate all groups with one statutory province tier or validate Natural Earth's specific polygon edges.
completeness_and_license_findings: Natural Earth is public domain and generalized. Official service pages and plans have purpose-specific island membership and do not establish exhaustive coastline/islet coverage for the retained polygons.
recommendation: A future source profile should name the intended group role and allowed source families; do not derive boundary policy solely from service labels or Natural Earth ADM1 tags.

scoped_source_context: Natural Earth 1:10m ADM1 island features; U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service refuge descriptions
source_role_and_suitability_findings: USFWS provides island identities and terrestrial-versus-submerged refuge area distinctions for Baker, Howland and Jarvis, and describes Palmyra's many islets/lagoon and marine refuge. These support separate physical units but refuge polygons are not their land boundaries.
completeness_and_license_findings: Natural Earth is public domain and generalized. USFWS acreage and refuge/monument extent are not redistributable coastline vectors and include large marine areas; no complete current land-outline source was validated here.
recommendation: Keep U.S. parents distinct from adjacent Kiribati Line Islands. Define a physical dry-land source policy and retain exact land evidence before any island completeness claim.
